messages:
dana_am: Heads-up  GovHealth Network (acct GH-999) disputed two invoices (INV-2026-8201, INV-2026-8233) citing a partner markup on routed inference. Theyre asking for a retroactive reseller adjustment totalling $34,200 and Net60 for future invoices while the partner audit runs. Can we approve as an exception?

kevin_sales: Customer escalated to procurement. Theyre running pilot across 3 hospitals; pipeline value ~USD 480k ARR if we keep momentum. Partner admits routing rule added latency and an extra hop but disputes markup responsibility.

fiona_finance: That's >$10k and multi-invoice; need deal desk packet. Is both invoices posted? revenue recognition impact? GL guidance?

dana_am: Both posted (2026-09-02 and 2026-09-10). Billing period Aug 20Sep 5. If we credit full amount, contra-rev impact this quarter.

harper_revops: We should ask partner for remediation and to cover any verified partner-side markup. Recommend split: Redwood covers a capped courtesy credit of up to $12k now to avoid churn, partner covers remainder if audit confirms their markup. Also require signed amendment limiting future concessions.

pricing-bot: CM-2026-412 queued for $34,200. Approval status: pending finance + exec review.

ana_legal: I'll draft an amendment with three clauses: 1) one-time credit limited to specified invoices, 2) temporary Net60 through 2026-12-31 pending audit, 3) partner audit clause obligating partner to reimburse if markup confirmed. Also explicit no-precedent language.

fiona_finance: Finance position: can pre-approve up to $12k without exec; anything over needs CFO/VP sign-off and NetSuite memo. GL code will be 7302 (Customer Credits - Exceptions). Need a 1-line business justification and ARR estimate for the deal desk packet.

kevin_sales: One-liner: "Prevent churn of strategic hospital consortium; pipeline ~480k ARR; expedited credit reduces procurement escalation."

vp_julia: I support a conditional compromise: Redwood issues an interim credit of $12k upon countersigned amendment; we open CM-2026-412 for remaining amount but hold posting until partner audit completes. Net60 granted for up to 90 days but will revert if audit negates partner responsibility. This avoids immediate full contra-rev.

cfo_oliver: I will not approve full $34.2k without audit results. Approve the interim $12k credit and temporary Net60 (90 days) conditional on amendment and partner audit trigger. If audit shows partner at fault, we will process partner reimbursement and post remaining credit. Document as CFO exception.

pricing-bot: Interim credit memo CM-2026-412-A created for $12,000. Status: pending countersignature and billing attach.

ana_legal: Amendment snippet for review:
```
Amendment: Redwood Inference will issue a one-time interim credit of $12,000 applied to INV-2026-8201 and INV-2026-8233 upon execution of this amendment. Redwood will grant a temporary Net60 payment term for invoices due within the next 90 days. This accommodation is conditional on the initiation of an independent partner audit; if the audit determines partner liability for markup, partner will reimburse Redwood for any additional credited amounts. This is a single-instance accommodation and does not change standard pricing or create precedent.
```

harper_revops: LGTM. I'll attach the amendment to CM-2026-412-A and notify partner to start audit within 5 business days.

fiona_finance: Once countersigned, billing can post CM-2026-412-A using GL 7302 and add NetSuite memo referencing CFO exception + amendment. We'll hold the remainder CM (CM-2026-412) pending audit outcome.

dana_am: I'll send the amendment to GovHealth and partner, copy legal and billing. Thanks all for the quick alignment.

kevin_sales: Sending to procurement now. Will update if they push for full immediate credit.

pricing-bot: Action items created: attach amendment to CM-2026-412-A, post interim credit after countersignature, start partner audit timeline.

dana_am: Resolving after CM posts. :white_check_mark:
